project: KitchenOps — commercial kitchen inventory depletion and smart restock logistics

test_cases.title: Log in with the 4-digit code sent to e-mail
steps: Open the application at index.html
Enter chef@kitchenops.internal in the email field and tap Send code
On the code screen, enter 1234 and tap Log in
test_cases.expected: The KitchenOps dashboard screen opens successfully with no password requested.

test_cases.title: A wrong login code is refused with an error message
test_cases.precondition: A 4-digit code has been requested for chef@kitchenops.internal
steps: On the code verification screen, enter 0000 in the code field
Tap Log in
test_cases.expected: The error message 'Wrong code. Check the e-mail and try again.' appears and the user remains on the code screen.

test_cases.title: An expired login code is refused with an error message
test_cases.precondition: A 4-digit code was sent to chef@kitchenops.internal more than 10 minutes ago
steps: On the code verification screen, enter the expired 4-digit code 1234
Tap Log in
test_cases.expected: The error message 'Expired code. Please request a new code.' appears and the server returns HTTP 401.

test_cases.title: An invalid email address format is refused with a 422 error
steps: Enter 'invalid-email-format' without an @ or domain in the email field
Tap Send code
test_cases.expected: The server rejects the payload with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity and highlights the malformed email field.

test_cases.title: Requesting a second login code within 60 seconds is refused with 429 Too Many Requests
test_cases.precondition: A 4-digit code has just been requested for chef@kitchenops.internal less than 60 seconds ago
steps: On index.html, re-enter chef@kitchenops.internal within 60 seconds
Tap Send code
test_cases.expected: The server refuses the request with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests and shows 'Please wait before requesting another code.'

test_cases.title: Querying current authenticated session profile returns user details or 401 when unauthorized
test_cases.precondition: User is authenticated with a valid bearer token
steps: Send GET request to /auth/me with Bearer token header
test_cases.expected: Server returns HTTP 200 with user email and kitchen role, or HTTP 401 when token is missing or invalid.

test_cases.title: Log 10 portions of Rigatoni Pomodoro to deplete raw ingredients
steps: Tap 'Log Prepared Dishes' on the dashboard
Select 'Rigatoni Pomodoro (120g pasta, 80g sauce)' as the recipe
Enter 10 in the completed portions field
Tap 'Confirm & Deplete Stock'
test_cases.expected: The confirmation screen opens displaying Audit Log #TX-9042 with 1.2 kg pasta and 0.8 kg tomato sauce deducted from stock.

test_cases.title: Submitting invalid portion count of zero is prevented
steps: Select 'Rigatoni Pomodoro' as the recipe
Enter 0 in the completed portions field
Tap 'Confirm & Deplete Stock'
test_cases.expected: The form prevents submission and displays 'Please enter at least 1 portion' without depleting stock.

test_cases.title: Stock dropping below safety threshold generates automated supplier PO
test_cases.precondition: Cooking cream stock is at 3.5 L, which is below the 5.0 L safety threshold
steps: Open 'Orders' from the navigation tabs or dashboard alert
Inspect pending purchase order PO-2026-041
Tap 'Dispatch Purchase Order'
test_cases.expected: The order screen displays a 20.0-liter replenishment entry for cooking cream and dispatches PO-2026-041 to Wholesale Dairy.

test_cases.title: Stock above safety threshold does not trigger unneeded purchase order
test_cases.precondition: Pasta inventory is healthy at 13.3 kg with safety threshold set to 5.0 kg
steps: Open 'Live Inventory' from the navigation tabs
Verify pasta stock level and active status badge
test_cases.expected: Pasta is tagged with green 'In Stock' badge and no pending replenishment draft appears for pasta.

test_cases.title: Perishable batch expiring within 48 hours displays amber alert banner
test_cases.precondition: Cooking Cream batch #B-104 expires in 36 hours
steps: Open 'Live Inventory' from the navigation tabs
test_cases.expected: An amber alert box displays 'FIFO Alert (48h Spoilage Window): Lot #B-104 expires on Oct 14' with priority rotation label.

test_cases.title: Oldest unexpired batch is prioritized for recipe depletion over newer batch
test_cases.precondition: Pasta has two batches in storage: Lot #P-201 (arrived Oct 01) and Lot #P-208 (arrived Oct 10)
steps: Open 'Log Prep Dish' and view the FIFO lot source preview card for Rigatoni Pomodoro
test_cases.expected: The preview explicitly attributes depletion to the older Lot #P-201 in accordance with FIFO rules.

test_cases.title: Record inbound wholesale delivery of 25kg flour into inventory
steps: Tap 'Receive Inbound Deliveries' from dashboard or inventory
Select 'All-Purpose Flour (25 kg bag)' as the delivered ingredient
Verify quantity 25, batch LOT-FL-20261013, and expiry date 2027-04-15
Tap 'Verify & Increment Stock'
test_cases.expected: The inventory screen opens confirming the newly received flour batch is added to active stock.

test_cases.title: Every screen fits a mobile phone viewport 390 px wide
test_cases.precondition: Browser phone simulation view is set to 390 px width
steps: Navigate sequentially through index.html, code.html, home.html, prep.html, prep_success.html, inventory.html, order.html, order_success.html, and receiving.html
test_cases.expected: No screen displays horizontal scrollbars, text is fully legible, and interactive buttons are comfortably accessible.
